scope: One fading-memory CUSUM candidate, no grid search or replacement of frozen models

normalization.scale: median and 1.4826 MAD, original sensor-type floors, then per-channel tail scale

cumulative.interpretation: Exponential fading, not a hard 24-hour cutoff; half-life fixed to existing 96-point/24-hour feature scale before evaluation

calibration.each_variant: Own April group 0.995 quantiles and global max-score 0.995 threshold; same protocol, not equal false-positive rate

events.valid: Current and prior 96 samples finite; current speed 6050-8500; reset at invalid output and timestamp gaps
events.paired: New event strictly after synthetic onset and at least 2 h before synthetic endpoint; exclude paired raw-control alarm at event and previous two samples

evaluation_data.main: All existing controlled-v2 training main scenes whose full source background starts >= May 1 and ends before July 1; retain censored outputs, no invented endpoints
evaluation_data.stress: All nonoverlapping 1536-point candidate-normal blocks within May-June; original ramp/plateau rules, three groups, amplitudes 0.5/1.0, durations 24/72/168/288 h, prelude 96 points, plateau 48 h
evaluation_data.empirical: All May-June raw observations, split only at time gaps; do not delete high-alarm or non-candidate periods
evaluation_data.generator_limitation: Existing v2 amplitudes and v1 stress scales use Jan-June statistics; this is model-forward training-side diagnosis, not a fully forward-generated independent test
evaluation_data.plateau: Remaining active after a plateau is not fault-resolution truth; never interpret fading alarm as restored equipment health

advance_rule.purpose: Conservative pilot screening rule, not a project or publication acceptance target
all_required: candidate combined empirical active fraction strictly below baseline combined
candidate combined longest observed active episode no longer than baseline
candidate combined main paired >=2h count no lower than baseline
candidate combined paired >=2h count no lower in each stress duration/amplitude stratum
candidate combined retains every baseline-CUSUM-only timely hit against EWMA in weak 168h/288h stress strata
advance_rule.stop: If any condition fails or support is absent, do not advance; report complete results and do not change half-life, thresholds, evaluation scenes or rules in this run

no_final_test_use: Do not parse July-December observations, train on them, or rescore them. Historical knowledge motivated this candidate, so this is explicitly post-test exploration.
